message.modlist.ignored_entries: Joined despite %s registry entries this client does not have, from: %s
message.modlist.server_only: The server has mods this client does not: %s
message.modlist.client_only: The server announced no channels for these mods of this client: %s
message.modlist.ignore_hint: modlist: to join anyway, turn on "Ignore Unknown Registry Entries" for this server in the modlist settings.
options.modlist.title: modlist Settings
options.modlist.join_notices.tooltip: After joining a server, list in chat the registry entries that were ignored and the mods only the server or only this client has. Joining is never blocked by these differences.
options.modlist.default_profile.tooltip: Settings for every server that has no server settings of its own.
options.modlist.server_profiles.tooltip: Settings for individual servers, chosen by address.
options.modlist.server_report.tooltip: What the last server announced and what this client reported to it.
options.modlist.server_report.none: Not connected to a server since the game started.
options.modlist.profile.address.tooltip: The address you connect to, ignoring case. Without a port it matches the server on any port; with a port, only that port. Invalid addresses are shown in red and not saved.
options.modlist.ignore_unknown_registry_: Join servers that have blocks, items or other content this client lacks, instead of being disconnected. That content appears as placeholders. Risky: the server may still disconnect you when it uses that content, other mods' blocks may look wrong, and the game may crash.
options.modlist.placeholders.tooltip: What the server's unknown blocks, items and entities appear as while unknown registry entries are ignored.
options.modlist.placeholders.title: Placeholders
options.modlist.placeholders.description: Leave a box empty to use the default shown in it.
options.modlist.placeholders.block.toolt: A block ID such as minecraft:barrier. Air is invisible and has no collision; solid blocks may make the server set you back.
options.modlist.placeholders.item.toolti: An item ID such as minecraft:barrier. With air, unknown items look like empty slots.
options.modlist.placeholders.entity_type: An entity type ID such as minecraft:armor_stand. The default marker is invisible.
options.modlist.report_mode.actual.descr: The real client brand and channels are reported.
options.modlist.report_mode.vanilla.desc: The client reports the brand "vanilla" and no mods, and its mods send nothing to the server.
options.modlist.report_mode.server.descr: The client claims every channel the server announces and hides the mods the server does not have.
options.modlist.report_mode.custom.descr: The brand, hidden mods and fake mods below are used.
options.modlist.mimic_vanilla.tooltip: Look like an unmodded client. Mods lose their multiplayer features. Fabric servers whose mods add required content still disconnect vanilla clients.
options.modlist.mimic_server.tooltip: Report the same mods as the server. If the server has content this client lacks, also turn on Ignore Unknown Registry Entries. The server may send data to the faked mods or wait for their answers.
options.modlist.restore_current.tooltip: Report the mods this client really has. The custom settings below are kept.
options.modlist.protect_hidden_translati: Servers can detect mods through translation keys and key binding names in signs and anvils. Hidden mods' keys stay untranslated there, as on a client without those mods.
options.modlist.brand.tooltip: The client brand reported in custom mode, for example vanilla. Leave empty to keep the real brand. Editing it switches to custom mode.
options.modlist.hidden_mods.tooltip: Mods whose channels are not reported and whose data is not sent to the server, in custom mode. Hidden mods lose their multiplayer features.
options.modlist.hidden_mods.title: Hidden Mods
options.modlist.hidden_mods.description: Servers only see mods through their channels. Mods without channels are not listed.
options.modlist.hidden_mods.fabric_warni: Fabric API's channels. Servers whose mods add content require them and disconnect clients that hide them.
options.modlist.hidden_mods.not_installe: No mod with channels in this namespace is installed.
options.modlist.fake_mods.tooltip: Mods to claim in custom mode although they are not installed. The server may send them data or wait for their answers.
options.modlist.fake_mods.title: Fake Mods
options.modlist.fake_mods.description: A mod ID claims every channel the server announces for it; a full channel ID claims that channel.
options.modlist.fake_mods.hint: Mod ID or channel, e.g. examplemod:handshake
options.modlist.server_profiles.title: Server Settings
options.modlist.server_profiles.descript: Each server uses the first settings whose address matches, or else the default settings.
options.modlist.server_profiles.shadowed: Never used: settings listed earlier match this address first.
options.modlist.report.title: Server Report
options.modlist.report.registry_namespac: Namespaces in the server's registry sync: %s
options.modlist.report.dropped: Mod data not sent: %s packets; login queries answered as unknown: %s
options.modlist.report.edit.tooltip: Opens this server's settings, creating them from the default settings if needed.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.modlist: Lets you edit the mod-related communication with servers: join despite mismatched mods, and choose which mods the server sees.
